_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 38 (Judah and Tamar). Saadia-specific: v.15 'ממתעה' = 'one who gives pleasure' (Saadia's gloss for זונה — euphemistic); v.21 'הקדשה' similarly rendered as 'one in the marketplace [for pleasure]'; v.29 'מא אחסן נמווך יא נאמי' = 'how good your growth, O Growing One' — Saadia preserves the etymology of Perez ('breaking forth/growing').

translations.1: And it was at that time also, that Judah went down from his brothers, and turned aside to an Adullamite man, whose name was Hirah.
translations.2: And he saw there the daughter of a Canaanite man, whose name was Shua; and he married her, and came in to her.
translations.3: And she conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
translations.4: And she conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
translations.5: Then she repeated again, and bore a son; and she named him Shelah. And Judah was at Keziv when she bore him.
translations.6: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn; her name was Tamar.
translations.7: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was evil in the sight of God; and He put him to death.
translations.8: And Judah said to Onan: 'Come in to your brother's wife, and produce by her — and raise up offspring for your brother.'
translations.9: And Onan knew that the offspring would not be ascribed to him; and whenever he came in to his brother's wife, he wasted it upon the ground — so as not to give offspring to his brother.
translations.10: And what he did was evil before God; and He put him to death also.
translations.11: And Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law: 'Dwell as a widow in your father's house, until Shelah my son grows up' — for he said: 'Lest he also die like his brothers.' And Tamar went, and dwelt in her father's house.
translations.12: And the days grew long; and the daughter of Shua, Judah's wife, died. And he was consoled after her; and he went up to his sheep-shearers — he and Hirah his Adullamite friend — to Timnah.
translations.13: And Tamar was told, saying: 'Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.'
translations.14: And she took off her garments of mourning, and covered herself with a veil, and wrapped herself; and she sat in a public place on the way to Timnah — for she saw that Shelah had grown up, and she had not been given to him as a wife.
translations.15: And Judah saw her, and reckoned her one who gives pleasure — for she had covered her face.
translations.16: And he turned aside to her on the way, and said: 'If you consent, I shall come in to you' — for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said: 'What will you give me, that you may come in to me?'
translations.17: He said: 'I shall send a young goat from the flock.' She said: 'Give me a pledge, until you send it.'
translations.18: He said: 'What is the pledge that I shall give you?' She said: 'Your seal, your cord, and your staff which is in your hand.' And he gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
translations.19: And she rose and went away; and she removed her veil from her, and put on her garments of mourning.
translations.20: And Judah sent the young goat, by the hand of his Adullamite friend, to redeem the pledge from the woman's hand; but he did not find her.
translations.21: And he asked the people of her place, and said: 'Where is the one who gives pleasure — she who was in a public place on the way?' They said: 'There has never been here one who gives pleasure.'
translations.22: And he returned to Judah, [and] said: 'I did not find her; and also the people of the place said, "There has been no woman of pleasure here."'
translations.23: Judah said: 'Then let her take it for herself, lest we become a mockery. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you did not find her.'
translations.24: And it was after three months, that Judah was told, and they said to him: 'Tamar your daughter-in-law has played the harlot; and behold, she is with child by harlotry.' He said: 'Bring her out, that she may be burned.'
translations.25: As she was being brought out — she sent to him, and said: 'By the man whose these articles are — I am with child.' Then she said: 'Identify — whose are this seal, and this cord, and this staff?'
translations.26: And Judah identified them, and said: 'She has been truthful in this against me — for I did not give her to Shelah my son.' And he did not again come in to her.
translations.27: And at the time of her bearing — behold, twins in her womb.
translations.28: And when she bore — one of them put out his hand; and the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it upon it, and said: 'This one came out first.'
translations.29: But when he drew back his hand — behold, his brother came out; and she said: 'How good is your growth, O Growing One!' And he named him Perez.
translations.30: And after that came out his brother, on whose hand was the scarlet; and he named him Zerah.
